Panel writes bg-brand-500 p-18 as px-18 py-18 bg-(--color-brand-500): the same variable and the four padding longhands, equal in the styles layer, a tree WITNESS. Pill changes px-2 to px-3 beside bg-brand-900, a token the theme does not define: unknown. Plain is untouched.
